items.name: GitHub
items.description: GitHub's hosted MCP server: issues, pull requests, code search, commits and repository files. Authenticates with each run owner's personal MCP token (a GitHub personal access token).

items.name: Context7
items.description: Up-to-date, version-specific library documentation and code examples pulled straight into the agent's context.

items.name: DeepWiki
items.description: Ask questions about any public GitHub repository and read its generated wiki. No authentication required.

items.name: Microsoft Learn
items.description: Search and fetch official Microsoft and Azure documentation. No authentication required.

items.name: Cloudflare Docs
items.description: Search Cloudflare developer documentation (Workers, R2, D1, networking). No authentication required.

items.name: Linear
items.description: Read and manage Linear issues, projects and comments. Authenticates with each run owner's personal MCP token (a Linear API key).

items.name: Hugging Face
items.description: Search models, datasets, Spaces and papers on the Hugging Face Hub. Authenticates with each run owner's personal MCP token (a Hugging Face access token).
